meta.name: paid-ads-setup
meta.description: Connect NotFair paid-ad accounts and establish reusable campaign context. Use when setting up paid media in a new workspace, connecting Google, Meta, X, or LinkedIn Ads, refreshing brand context, or preparing an agent to work on ads safely.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 连接主流广告账户,备好品牌信息供投放助手使用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要让 AI 助手安全上手广告投放,先把账户和品牌上下文备好
copy.tagline_en: Connect paid ad accounts and load brand context for AI ad assistants
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want an AI assistant to manage ads safely with your brand context ready.

howto.what: Claude 连接并核对 NotFair 广告账户,只列出真实存在的账户供选择;读取营销资料、仅追问数据无法判断的缺口,不改动广告;结束时输出差距清单与建议。
howto.when: 当你在新工作区设置付费广告、连接 Google/Meta/X 等广告账户,或刷新品牌背景等场景触发。

say.text: 连接我的 Google Ads 账户,建立广告背景。
say.note: 会先核对账户再让你确认。

say.text: 把 Meta 广告账户接入 NotFair,并整理产品、预算等背景。
say.note: 只补充数据里没有的信息。

say.text: 准备让代理安全处理广告,先做账户和背景设置。
say.note: 会生成差距清单和下一步。

howto.what_en: Claude verifies NotFair ad accounts, lists only real ones, asks only unanswered context questions, does not alter campaigns, and reports gaps and next steps.
howto.when_en: Triggers when setting up paid media in a new workspace, connecting Google/Meta/X ad accounts, refreshing brand context, or preparing an agent to handle ads safely.

say_en.text: Connect my Google Ads account and set up ad context.
Connect my Meta Ads account in NotFair and collect product/budget context.
say_en.note: Only adds missing info not in data.

say_en.text: Prepare an agent to work on ads safely; do setup and context first.
say_en.note: Produces a gap register and next steps.
